# User need

Describe who needs the capability, the current limitation, and the outcome it should enable.

## Proposed behavior

Give a concrete workflow or example, acceptance criteria, and scope boundaries. Identify whether this extends implemented behavior or the planned architecture.

## Alternatives and compatibility

Explain alternatives considered and any implications for plugins, profiles, protocols, or existing workflows.

## Environment and validation

List relevant platforms and server/protocol variants. Describe how the result could be verified with local or synthetic inputs.

Include only redacted evidence. Do not share credentials, private transcripts, or live user profiles.
